claimLedger.claim: Lists heaviness/bulge/sex/bladder/bowel symptoms; see GP for lump or other symptoms; outlines examination, grading 1–4, and options including pessary, physio, hormones, surgery; monitoring if not bothered.

claimLedger.claim: History and exam for prolapse; POP-Q in specialist care; discuss no/non-surgical/surgical options; consider ≥16 weeks supervised PFMT for symptomatic stage 1 or 2.

claimLedger.claim: Consider ≥4 months supervised PFMT for symptomatic prolapse not extending >1 cm beyond hymen on straining.
